groups.title: Electrical Construction

about.title: Built for complex work.
text: Emerald Standard is a Houston-based electrical contractor built for complex work. Since 2001, we have delivered electrical construction, design-build, and technically demanding installations for some of Southeast Texas's most important facilities, including airports, healthcare campuses, higher education, transportation, government, and other mission-critical environments. From the beginning, the company has been shaped by a rare combination of engineering depth, field resourcefulness and entrepreneurial grit.

That spirit began with our founder's journey. Roy Pombrol came to the United States from Cuba as a refugee in 1966, built a new life through hard work and perseverance, earned his electrical engineering degree, and went on to lead major electrical construction operations over a long career. When changing political conditions forced another fresh start, he and his son, Roger, founded the company together.

What makes us different is the way we bring engineering thinking into construction. As a licensed electrical contractor with licensed engineering capability, we do more than install systems. We help solve difficult problems before they disrupt the job.

For our clients, that means a partner who can think ahead, coordinate effectively and execute with fewer surprises in the field. For our people, it means working in an environment where planning, accountability and respect are more than words; they shape the way the job gets done every day.

Our story is rooted in perseverance, technical excellence, and respect for the people we serve. We aim to be the electrical contractor clients trust when the work is complex, the stakes are high, and reliable execution matters most.
